description: AgentsKit base Renovate preset: weekly grouped minor/patch with green-CI automerge, monthly grouped majors. Use: github>AgentsKit-io/agentskit//renovate-base

packageRules.description: Group all minor and patch updates into one weekly PR; automerge is opt-in per dependency type below
Automerge (Renovate-side, only after CI is green) minor/patch/digest of devDependencies; production dependencies stay manual until branch protection requires CI checks
Group all major updates into one monthly PR; never automerge
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
